blocks.text: Lusaka Contemporary Art Centre supports Zambia’s creative community through a residency dedicated to artistic experimentation, research, and professional exchange.

Established in 2023, Lusaka Contemporary Art Centre (LuCAC) is an independent, non-profit, artist-led institution committed to advancing contemporary Zambian art. Its one-month residency invites artists, curators, researchers, writers and cultural practitioners from across Zambia to develop their practices within an interdisciplinary environment.

Selected participants receive accommodation, dedicated studio space, material support, mentorship and opportunities to present their work. Transport assistance is also available to selected practitioners travelling from outside Lusaka.

By extending opportunities beyond the capital, the programme helps strengthen Zambia’s independent cultural infrastructure, encourages creative exchange, and supports the development of locally grounded artistic practices. Lusaka Contemporary Art Centre+1
The residency takes place at Lusaka Contemporary Art Centre , Chamba Valley, Lusaka, Zambia.
